text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Regarding our planned shopping run for 
today... The weather looks like it's about 
to turn, so I suggest we postpone it."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my gosh!! What terrible timing! To go 
and ruin our plans like this!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
According to the weather radar, a 
thundercloud is expected to pass over this 
area in 30 minutes...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I-I see... Thunder, huh? Thunder is 
coming, right? I-I see..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Craft. I can tell, you know. 
You're actually excited about the thunder, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe~! Something about it just draws me 
in.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Look, the sound is amazing, right? Like, 
KABOOM! Doesn't hearing that just make you 
super pumped up?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...I see. That's a sensibility I do not 
possess.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Finding strength and elegance even in 
natural phenomena— you truly have a rich 
sensibility, Craft-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...If possible, I too would like to have a 
unique sensibility like Kraft-san's.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ohh...? I'm not totally sure why, but I 
got praised. Ehehe~.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Liking lightning, yearning for it... 
Honestly, what am I going to do with you 
all...?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"You really are so unique and fun! Being 
with you, I don't think I'll ever get 
bored. Heheh!"
